rows.grounds: optative of bhū expressing a wish
compound epithet addressing the highest goddess
companion or assistant in the desired role
negation forming the condition with cet

items.question: Under what condition is the supreme goddess asked to become an eager helper?
premises: The addressee is the supreme goddess.
The speaker wishes her to be a helper.
The desired help is characterized by eager willingness.
The request depends on the absence of unwillingness.
items.inference: If she is willing, the supreme goddess is asked to become an eager helper.
items.plain_english: O supreme goddess, if you are willing, may you become my eager helper.
